result.description:
Quality Assurance Officer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

The Role
As QA Officer, you are responsible for ensuring that all products and services consistently meet established quality standards and regulatory requirements. This involves performing tests, identifying defects, documentation, and assisting in process improvements.

Your Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Conduct routine quality assurance inspections and testing of materials, components to ensure compliance with Australian Standards and ISO 9001 quality requirements
Develop and implement quality control plans (QCP) and inspection test plans (ITP) for mechanical systems, welding, and assembly operations
Maintain, review, and update quality documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records, and, in some cases, product specifications
Monitor and ensure product quality throughout the production process, following ISO 9001 and industry-specific standards
Investigate product quality issues, identify root causes, and prepare reports on non-conforming materials or processes
Prepare detailed quality documentation including test reports, inspection records, and final dossiers for client handover
Collaborate with design, production, and maintenance teams to resolve quality issues and ensure continuous improvement of products
Ensure testing equipment is properly maintained, calibrated, and used according to protocols
Ensure compliance with Work Health and Safety (WHS) requirements in all QA-related activities
Coordinate third-party inspections and liaise with suppliers to verify conformance of mechanical parts and supplied materials, ensuring they meet company standards
Document quality assurance activities and create audit reports.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in quality assurance or a similar field.
Working knowledge of tools, methods, and concepts of quality assurance.
Solid knowledge of relevant regulatory standards.
Good communication skills, both verbal and written.
Excellent data collection and analysis skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with high attention to detail.

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Summary
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Machine Operator to join our clients team in the steel industry. As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining a variety of metalworking machinery to produce high-quality metal products. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to safety will play a crucial role in our manufacturing process.
 
Company
Based in Marrickville, our company specializes in the production of a diverse range of metal products, including tables, chairs, trolleys, and other innovative solutions. They pride in their commitment to quality craftsmanship and cutting-edge design.
 
Responsibilities

Integra Water Treatment Solutions is a national, Australian-owned company specialising in Water Treatment, Waste Water, Pre-Treatment and Cleaning and Hygiene chemicals.  
Due to an internal promotion our Adelaide operation is looking for a Fitter to work in our Pre-Treatment and Filtration Division.
Responsibilities
Engineering and Fabrication
•	Interpret technical engineering drawings, blueprints, and P&IDs to plan the fabrication and assembly of filtration systems, selecting correct materials and specialised tooling configurations.
•	Configure workshop machine tools (mills, lathes) by adjusting stops, guides, dies, and control settings for precise operations.
•	Shape and finish customised stainless steel parts and skid frames by operating milling and lathe machines.
•	Weld stainless steel pipework, brackets, and structural frames for water treatment plant skids.
•	Select and fabricate high-pressure pipework and fittings (schedule-rated PVC, stainless, tri-clamp/flanged joints) to correct pressure ratings.
•	Assemble industrial water equipment by integrating manufactured components and aligning motor-pump subunits into fully functioning mechanical systems.
•	Assemble and overhaul industrial pumps (feed, transfer, high-pressure), fitting impellers, shafts, and mechanical seals.
Installation and Commissioning
•	Install and align high-pressure feed pumps, energy recovery devices, and couplings to spec.
•	Install and route fluid transfer systems by measuring, shaping, joining, and securing hydraulic, pneumatic, and process tubing.
•	Install pretreatment, micro/ultrafiltration, and reverse osmosis skids, including membrane and module fitment, manifold connections, and correct alignment.
•	Install multimedia filters, water softeners, and cartridge pre-filter housings, including resin bed setup and multiport/backwash valve configuration.
•	Install and calibrate chemical dosing systems (antiscalant, dechlorination, pH correction, coagulant/flocculant), including dosing pump setup and injection point plumbing.
•	Load, align, and torque RO membrane pressure vessels and elements to spec (membrane orientation, o-ring/interconnector fitment, end cap torque).
•	Install and set feed, reject, permeate-diversion, flush, and air scour valves (manual and actuated).
•	Fit and calibrate process instrumentation — pressure transmitters, flow meters, conductivity/TDS probes.
•	Inspect completed components with calibrated gauges and measuring devices to verify dimensional precision and tolerances.
•	Pressure- and leak-test assembled skids and pipework prior to commissioning, to correct hydrostatic/operating standards.
•	Commission plant equipment and set correct automated sequencing across pretreatment, MF/UF, and RO trains.
Service and Troubleshooting
•	Diagnose mechanical malfunctions, conduct preventive servicing, and restore performance of plant machinery.
•	Service and rebuild industrial pumps, replacing worn or damaged impellers, shafts, and mechanical seals.
•	Service multimedia filters, water softeners, and cartridge pre-filter housings, including resin bed servicing, backwash timing adjustment, and seal replacement.
•	Service and troubleshoot backwash, CEB, and CIP systems across pretreatment, MF/UF, and RO trains.
•	Troubleshoot and repair automated and manual valve faults (feed, reject, permeate-diversion, flush, air scour).
•	Troubleshoot and recalibrate process instrumentation to restore correct process control.

Requirements
•	Relevant Qualification or 3 years of experience in lieu of the qualification.
•	At least 1 year of experience in the relevant role.
•	Ability to work under pressure.
•	Excellent attention to detail.
•	Confident manner.
